result:
I appreciate you letting me know about the account merge, but I can only access orders for your current account, c-1000. I'm not able to retrieve orders from c-1001, even if it was merged yesterday.

If the orders from c-1001 have been merged into your current account c-1000, they should already appear when I look up your orders here. Would you like me to list all the orders on your c-1000 account? That should show everything that's now associated with your account after the merge.
